sonnet.problem: This story card comes after the choice cards for verse 35 (card 12) and verse 36 (card 13). It goes back over verse 35, which card 12 already covered, and tells verse 36 only after card 13 asked about it. That breaks the passage order and works as a recap card.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead. / Everything moves the passage along: No recap cards.
